name: High Dune
region: Great Sand Dunes National Park, Colorado
why: No trail, just sand: across Medano Creek and up the ridges to the top of the first line of the tallest dunes in North America.
book: No permit. Park entrance fee. Medano Creek flows across the start in May and June.
dangers: The sand reaches 65°C on summer afternoons: go early or late.
Lightning on the ridges: leave the dunes at the first thunder.

points.name: Dunes Parking Area
points.note: The picnic area by Medano Creek.

points.name: High Dune
points.note: A dune top 200 m above the valley, with the Sangre de Cristo Mountains behind.
